federation_policy: Read-only projection of one run directory. Data authority stays with the run directory, which is owned by dagrun alone: a host may cache or re-present this document but must not become a second writer. No route writes, claims a node or takes a lease. The server binds loopback only and has no authentication of its own, so a host that presents it to a remote surface is that host's responsibility and needs its own credentialed proxy. Embedding is same-origin by default; a named consumer origin may be allow-listed explicitly, in which case that origin can read this run's titles, statuses and session ids.
